title: One-dimensional and planar random motions with variable propagation speeds
summary: In this paper, we study univariate and planar random motions with variable propagation speeds. We first consider motions with space-varying velocity, which can be reduced to constant-velocity motions by means of suitable nonlinear transformations. We examine a special case of a motion which is confined within the unit interval. To provide a general expression of the moments of this process, we introduce a new family of polynomials which generalize the classical Euler polynomials.
